elements.name: midday small town in Ethiopian highlands
young man seen from behind in centre
old boxy country bus with door open
bundles tied on bus roof rack
plain bus front with no sign or plate
low houses with rusty corrugated tin roofs and mud-plastered walls
tall thin eucalyptus trees with drooping leaves
sun high overhead with short shadows

wrong_setting: The man faces a single round thatched-roof hut with stone base and glazed windows instead of a country bus; there are no tin-roofed houses, no eucalyptus trees and no town, so it reads as a rural homestead, not a highland town bus stop.
notes: Replace the thatched hut with the boxy country bus (door open, bundles on roof rack, blank front), add tin-roofed mud houses and eucalyptus trees, and paint the scene fully to all four edges with no pale paper margins.
